# Check and remove the random "I" loci

```{r}
remove <- which(show_loci(madagascar)$allele_ref=="I")
madagascar <- madagascar %>% select_loci(-all_of(c(remove)))
count_loci(madagascar)
```

# Update build

Add a section here with the biomart function/find a better way to do this?

```{r}
new_bim_no_NA <- read.table("/home/EJC199/Dropbox/gitdata/malagasy_diversity/data/intermediate/Madagascar_full_HG38.bim", header = FALSE)
colnames(new_bim_no_NA) <- c("chromosome", "snp_id", "genetic_dist", "physical_pos", "allele1", "allele2")

# select the loci with updated positions

madagascar <- madagascar %>% select_loci_if(loci_names(genotypes) %in% new_bim_no_NA$snp_id)

#find matching indices
match_indices <- match(show_loci(madagascar)$name, new_bim_no_NA$snp_id)
matching_rows <- !is.na(match_indices)

# update position
show_loci(madagascar)$position[matching_rows] <- new_bim_no_NA$physical_pos[match_indices[matching_rows]]

# update chromosome
show_loci(madagascar)$chromosome <- as.character(show_loci(madagascar)$chromosome)
show_loci(madagascar)$chromosome[matching_rows] <- new_bim_no_NA$chromosome[match_indices[matching_rows]]

# update chr_int
chr_update <- which(show_loci(madagascar)$chr_int == 0)
show_loci(madagascar)$chr_int[chr_update] <- as.integer(show_loci(madagascar)$chromosome[chr_update])


count_loci(madagascar)

```

After updating to HG38 we are left with 692673 SNPs.

# Create loci report

```{r}
loci_report_m <- qc_report_loci(madagascar)
summary(loci_report_m)
autoplot(loci_report_m, type = "overview")
```


The following autoplots help to examine other QC measures in greater detail.

```{r}
autoplot(loci_report_m, type = "missing")
```

The automatic threshold for missingness (0.01) fits the data well, so we will stick to this threshold.

```{r}
madagascar <- madagascar %>% select_loci_if(loci_missingness(genotypes)<0.01)
count_loci(madagascar)
```

```{r}
autoplot(loci_report_m, type = "maf")
```

The MAF distribution of this dataset has a skew? is it because of the chip used? <https://academic.oup.com/gbe/article/5/5/1021/611342>

```{r}
madagascar <- madagascar %>% select_loci_if(loci_maf(genotypes)>0.025)
count_loci(madagascar)
```


We do not want to be too stringent on filter out variants deviating from HWE,  because HWE can indicate processes that we are intending to investigate (assortative mating, stratified population structures etc see Turner et al. 2011). 

We can check hwe within sub-populations:

```{r}
hwe_res <- madagascar %>% group_by(population) %>% group_map(.f = ~loci_hwe(.x))
hwe_res <- do.call("cbind",hwe_res)
hwe_res <- as.data.frame(hwe_res)

#to_remove <- rownames(hwe_res)[apply(hwe_res,1,function(row) any(row < 0.05))]
#length(to_remove)

#to_remove <- rownames(hwe_res)[apply(hwe_res,1,function(row) all(row < 0.05))]

# which criteria to use?

to_remove <- rownames(hwe_res)[apply(hwe_res,1,function(row) sum(row < 0.05) >= 3)]
length(to_remove)
to_keep <- as.numeric(setdiff(rownames(hwe_res), to_remove))
```

Removing snps where p<0.05 in 3 or more of the 5 populations

```{r}
madagascar <- madagascar %>% select_loci(all_of(to_keep))
count_loci(madagascar)
```

We also want to remove all non-autosomal SNPs.

```{r}
madagascar <- madagascar %>% select_loci_if(show_loci(genotypes)$chromosome %in% c(1:22)) 
count_loci(madagascar)
```

# Create individual report

```{r}
madagascar <- madagascar %>% group_by(population)
individual_report_m <- qc_report_indiv(madagascar, kings_threshold = 0.177)
summary(individual_report_m)
autoplot(individual_report_m)
```

The autoplot indicates that no individuals have greater than 5% of their genotypes missing, so we do not need to filter for missingness by individual in this case.

For now, we also do not want to remove individuals with low heterozygosity, as we may want to analyse ROH across individuals in the dataset.

```{r}
autoplot(individual_report_m, type = "relatedness",kings_threshold = 0.177)
```

```{r}
madagascar <- madagascar %>% ungroup()
madagascar <- madagascar %>% filter(id %in% individual_report_m$id & individual_report_m$to_keep == TRUE)
```

As the datasets will contain more closely related inviduals, we don't want to be too strict in removing. For now, we can remove first degree relatives.

The challenge is how to remove as few individuals as possible while still removing all relationships above this kinship threshold.

See <https://www.kingrelatedness.com/manual.shtml#>:\~:text=Close%20relatives%20can%20be%20inferred,%2Ddegree%2C%20and%203rd%2Ddegree for kinship thresholds.

```{r}
nrow(madagascar)
count_loci(madagascar)
```

Now we have a cleaned dataset, we can save this gt for future use.

```{r}
gt_save(madagascar, file = resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_full_cleaned.gt"))
```


Next we can read in and clean other Malagasy data ready to merge with.

```{r}
# append population info

pop_table <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_Borneo.poptable"), sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)
colnames(pop_table) <- c("IID", "V2","FID","Population","V5","V6","V7")

hwe_res <- madagascar_p %>% group_by(population) %>% group_map(.f = ~loci_hwe(.x))
hwe_res <- do.call("cbind",hwe_res)

to_remove <- rownames(hwe_res)[apply(hwe_res,1,function(row) sum(row < 0.05) >= 2)]
length(to_remove)
to_keep <- as.numeric(setdiff(rownames(hwe_res), to_remove))
```

# 1000 G

Cutting down to populations of interest

```{r}
#g1000 <- gen_tibble(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/1000_Genomes_b37_clean.bed"), quiet = TRUE)
g1000 <- gt_load(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/1000_Genomes_b37_clean.gt"))

# append population info
pop_table <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_Borneo.poptable"), sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)
colnames(pop_table) <- c("IID", "V2","FID","Population","V5","V6","V7")

pop_table_sub <- subset(pop_table,pop_table$IID %in% g1000$id)

matching_m <- match(g1000$id, pop_table_sub$IID)
g1000$population <- ifelse(!is.na(matching_m), pop_table_sub$V2[matching_m], g1000$population)

pop <- c("KHV","BEB","YRI","PJL","GWD","MSL","ESN","LWK","CHS")
#- Kinh in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
#- Bengali in Bangladesh
#- Han Chinese South
#- Luhya in Webuye, Kenya
#- Yoruba in Ibadan, Nigeria
#- Punjabi in Lahore, Pakistan
#- Gambian in Western Division, The Gambia - Mandinka
#- Mende in Sierra Leone
#- Esan in Nigeria

g1000 <- g1000 %>% filter(population %in% pop)

count_loci(g1000)
nrow(g1000)
```
